name: AR_CMGT_DATA_POINTS_B
description: This table contains the predefined credit data points.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_ID
columns.description: Data point unique identifier.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Category of the data point. Values are based on the lookup AR_CMGT_DATA_POINT_CATEGORY.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_CODE
columns.description: Data point internal name.

columns.name: DATA_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the data type for the data point. Valid values: D (Date), N (Number), C (VARCHAR2).

columns.name: SCORABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the data point can be used in scoring models for calculating credit scores.

columns.name: SYSTEM_DERIVED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the data point value is derived from system.

columns.name: DATA_POINT_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: This column identifies the source of the data point, distinguishing between data points originally from Credit, Collections, or a third-party source. This column is populated with values through the lookup ORA_UNIFIED_INV_DATA_SOURCE. Customers will be able to populate this lookup with third-party data providers they choose to integrate with.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application unique identifier.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if data point is enabled.

columns.name: RETURN_DATE_FORMAT
columns.description: Indicates date format, when DATA_TYPE column is date(D).

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: REFERENCED_FLAG
columns.description: This column identifies whether a data point value has been created in the repository for this data point.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
